title: Write Metadata — Tier 2 (Partial)
description: Partial metadata for the Write tool (file creation). Provenance is required. koth and decision are optional but recommended for significant file creation events (new feature files, configs, etc.). experiment and _compat not applicable.

notes.koth.outcome_signal: Set by PostToolUse. 'win' if file created successfully, 'loss' on error.
notes.koth.koth_domain: Domain of the content being written (e.g., 'frontend' for React components, 'backend' for API files).
notes.decision.signal_type: Typically 'post_decision' — Write executes on an already-made decision.
